rationale: 识别指标 repurchase_rate（约束取数口径）
解析出时间窗口（无时间窗问题由 NL2SQL 决策）

payload.sql: WITH per_user AS (SELECT o.region_id, o.customer_id, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(o.refund_amount) AS ref FROM fact_order o WHERE o.order_status='paid' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30' GROUP BY o.region_id, o.customer_id), agg AS (SELECT region_id, 100.0*COUNT(CASE WHEN n>=2 THEN 1 END)/COUNT(*) AS rep_rate FROM per_user WHERE ref=0 GROUP BY region_id) SELECT r.region_name, ROUND(a.rep_rate,2) AS repurchase_rate FROM agg a JOIN dim_region r ON r.region_id=a.region_id ORDER BY a.rep_rate DESC LIMIT 3
